content.title: Bhad Bhabie Receives 'Bad News' About Her Cancer Diagnosis | iHeart
content.text: Bhad Bhabie says she recently got some "bad news" about her cancer diagnosis. In a brief post she posted to X on Saturday, February 28, the social media star-turned-rapper shared that her doctor gave her an unfortunate update about her health. Bhad Bhabie was diagnosed with a form of blood cancer in 2024. She didn't reveal exactly what the update was, but she remained adamant that she will continue her battle and won't let the disease get the best of her. "Bad news from my doctor yesterday, god has the last say so not my cancer," she wrote. According to TMZ, Bhad Bhabie, born Danielle Bregoli, has been undergoing treatments for cancer since late 2024. In a video she posted last year, Bregoli shot down the rumors that she's fighting off breast cancer and confirmed she's suffering from blood cancer. She explained her white blood cell count is high, which is a sign of blood cancer or bone marrow disorder. She also addressed fans' questions about her weight loss. The "Gucci Flip Flops" artists blamed her sudden drop in weight on her cancer medication. Despite her ongoing cancer battle, Bhad Bhabie continues to live her life without caring what anyone has to say about her. Last year, the 21-year-old artist and influencer posted before-and-after shots of her new nose. She warned fans that nose jobs "are not for the weak" as she revealed her healing process. In the photos and videos, you can see bruises under her eyes from the surgery as she showed off the work that was done to her face. Bhad Bhabie explained that she wanted to "remove the hump" from her nose, and didn't care what her haters thought about her decision."Yall it doesn't matter if you liked my nose before... this is my face I didn't like it so I fixed it," she wrote in her Instagram Story.We wish Bhad Bhabie the best of luck as she continues to battle cancer.
